newsitem.title: USA: U.S. major appliance shipments slip in August.
newsitem.headline: U.S. major appliance shipments slip in August.

text.p: Major U.S. home appliance shipments in August declined 4.4 percent to 4.6 million units from 4.8 million units a year ago, reported the Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers.
However, year-to-date shipments rose 6.2 percent to 37.5 million units from 35.3 million.

The trade group said August was the second highest in the history of total major home appliance factory shipments, with gains recorded in three categories -- disposers, microwave ovens and electric surface cookers.

It said lower temperatures caused room air conditioners to fall by 71.1 percent in August. Dehumidifier shipments decreased by 52.8 percent. In addition, refrigerator shipments dropped 11.8 percent, freezers 24 percent and home laundry equipment fell 5.4 percent.
